purpose: Screen rectangular regulator leads and subsequent replacement, not qualify a socket assembly.
method: Manufacturer specifies rectangular lead diagonal as effective diameter. After insertion, maximum inserted diameter minus compliancy bounds the minimum subsequent diameter, also bounded by the original minimum.
limitations: Only the three named contact types are screened; this is not an exhaustive market search.
Full independent package width/thickness extrema used; no measured sample substituted for replacement tolerance.
No exact shell, plating, insertion depth, retention, contact temperature, fault current or China purchase route qualified.
Do not reshape, file or thin regulator leads to force a fit.
A hypothetical contact used by the checker is not a procurement candidate.
